title: Huruf Nenek
subject: a young man in Makassar learning the Bugis lontara script letter by letter from a primary-school workbook so he can read the folded letters his grandmother sent him while he worked in a Malaysian palm-oil plantation, which he kept for six years without ever reading
caption: Bugis-Makassar kecapi ballad from South Sulawesi. Boat-shaped two-string kecapi plucked in rippling repeated figures, a reedy single-stringed keso-keso fiddle shadowing the melody, gendang bugis hand drum played softly with fingers, warm acoustic bass. Intimate, wooden room sound with a little air. Gentle male baritone, close and conversational. 76 BPM, D minor. Slow-dawning, warm and quietly amused. No pop drum kit, no synth pads, no autotune, no trap, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - kecapi ripple, keso-keso enters]

[Verse 1]
Enam tahun di kebun sawit Sabah
Tiap bulan ada surat dari Bone
Hurufnya kayak gelombang kecil
Aku lipat, aku simpan, nggak kubaca

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku malu bilang nggak bisa
Nenek kira cucunya pintar

[Chorus]
Ka, ga, nga, aku eja pelan-pelan
Buku tulis anak kelas tiga
Surat pertama baru dua baris
Nenek tanya, sudah makan atau belum

[Verse 2]
Malam ini aku sampai surat kelima
Dia cerita ayam yang hilang
Dia cerita tetangga yang curang
Dia tulis, jangan kirim uang dulu

[Pre-Chorus]
Enam tahun dia ngobrol sendiri
Aku yang datang terlambat

[Chorus]
Ka, ga, nga, aku eja pelan-pelan
Tujuh puluh dua surat di kardus mi
Surat kelima akhirnya habis
Nenek tanya, kapan pulang ke Bone

[Bridge - kecapi alone]
Besok aku tulis balasan pertama
Hurufku miring, pasti dia ketawa

[Outro - kecapi and keso-keso, fading]
